code.text: SPEC

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
The patient shows microcytic anemia (low hemoglobin and hematocrit with normal MCV), mild metabolic acidosis (low CO₂), elevated alkaline phosphatase, and abnormal urine findings: significant proteinuria, glucosuria, ketonuria, and low specific gravity, with brown, cloudy urine. These findings suggest possible renal tubular dysfunction (e.g., Fanconi syndrome) and warrant further nephrological evaluation. Mildly elevated LDL and monocytes are also noted.
